The '''Shesharile system''' contained the inhabited [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Shesharile 5]] and [[Shesharile 6]] circling a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. These moons were commonly known throughout the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] by the misnomer "the [[Twin Planets]]."
